name: resume_listing
title: Resume Listing
summary: Grid of resume cards with view and download.
description: Grid of resume cards from data_items_resume.json (each <li> has the item _id as id): thumbnail and View button open resume_view in the popup (preview_popup: false turns it off), title opens the PDF, description, language, publish date and a Download button. "variant": "compact" drops the thumbnail and Download button: an icon, title, description, language, date and one View button (view_text) that links to view_page#<item _id>, where the popup opens from the hash; without view_page the button opens resume_view in a popup on the same page. Put a resume_filters with the same "id" before it for language / model filters, search and sort.
